To find the square (2) of a given number, multiply that number by itself.

To find the square root of a given number, figure out which number squared (multiplied by itself) equals that given number.

Every positive number has both a positive and a negative square root. The radical symbol (   ) means the positive square root.

content.html:

So,  (64)2 = 64.
